title: Power_Plant
lead_summary:
Accessible from Route 10 (Before Rock Tunnel), wild Pokémons now roam the abandoned Power Plant. The basement can only be accessed after the player obtained its key to open the gate, which is obtained after defeating Team Rocket at Mt. Ember. The final part of the basement where Zapdos is located is behind a gate that can only be opened with 5 Cell Batteries. Several Cell Batteries can be found throughout the Power Plant.
The basement has two encounter tables:
*B1F-1, when in the main hallways and colors are more greyed out.
*B1F-2, when in the side rooms and colors are more vivid.
